title: The Cloud Who Packed a Picnic | Giggle & Snooze Bedtime Read-Aloud
description:
Ollo wants to bring something to the picnic, but a pear and a little cup slip right through his fluffy arms. When the afternoon grows warm, the little cloud discovers he has something of his own to share.

This Giggle & Snooze picture book read-aloud for ages 3–6 starts with a pear rolling across a picnic blanket and settles into a quiet moment among friends. Its gentle pace gives little listeners time to wind down with a reassuring thought: everyone has something to share, and there’s room for everyone.
